admission_behavior.original_record: retained for audit and linked lineage
admission_behavior.positive_evidence: never granted by correction or retraction metadata
admission_behavior.tombstone_policy: tombstone or quarantine is reversible and preserves stable identifiers

authority: correction and retraction metadata changes record disposition; they never create positive evidence

rules.CORRECTED: retain original metadata, link the correction, and flag the original for manual review
rules.EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN: retain provenance and block positive evidence use pending manual review
rules.NOT_OBSERVED: no provider relation observed; do not infer that no relation exists
rules.RETRACTED: retain provenance, quarantine or tombstone positive-use eligibility, and link the retraction notice
rules.UNKNOWN: rights and correction state are unresolved; no positive evidence promotion
rules.UPDATED: retain the prior version and link the update; do not silently overwrite historical metadata
